notes.title: First Day Patch is out!
notes.notes:
Hey Players,  



We’ve just released HIDDEN PASS, and, after a lot of valuable feedback, we present to you the First Day Patch.



Here’s what’s new:  

🐜Bug fixes:

- Fixed several rare bugs (lvlups, building, names etc.)

⚖️Improvements:

- Started to tweak enemy damage 



We appreciate your reports and patience! Keep sharing feedback, and stay tuned for more updates.

notes.title: Beta Version is ready and we plan to start playtest very soon!
notes.notes:
Greetings Expedition Leaders!

Global Update:
The game has been updated to Version 0.6.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209218/1ad53ac579ca30f3fc50b777385e74b2d04a72e3.png

Changes:

 Reward System Rework: Defeating powerful enemies now grants Enriched Elyrium!

 New Mechanic: Events – Players may randomly encounter unique scenarios requiring strategic choices, leading to either beneficial or detrimental outcomes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209218/482770312d515b31b6070432462d0e37653ff068.png

 New Mechanic: Encounters – At the start and end of each chapter, players engage in text-based quests shaped by their perception of the situation. Their decisions influence short-term results and the game’s final ending.

 New effects added to gameplay.

 Hero Class Reworks: All hero classes have been overhauled for balance and diversity.

 New Ability – Concentrated Strike: Warrior-class heroes can now effectively engage flying enemies with this skill.


New Units Added:

 Zombie
 Lich
 Death Knight


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209218/67298d86c0b7a0fc8ac22fb134463bafd6e29ee1.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2430170/Hidden_Pass/

Good luck, Wanderers!

notes.title: Tons of new things and a big meta gameplay update!
notes.notes:
Greetings Expedition Leaders!


 Demons have been added to the game! In the upcoming versions, you'll be able to face them in battle.
[previewyoutube=Rql-kqbrtSE;full][/previewyoutube]
 The Chaos Adept can now summon minor and medium demons. You'll even be able to control them yourself!
 We've finished modeling the lesser undead and have moved on to animations for them. They'll soon have their turn to appear in the game! This brings the total to four monster races.
 We've completed the creation of a new gameplay cycle. As you remember, Hidden Pass will now feature runs, progression, and other roguelike elements.
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1093429412583702548/1315627729433133076/Roguelite_1_way.png?ex=678b83cd&is=678a324d&hm=755b23b7f97a3b25412bc3ec658c462c37bf81dbb73baebfc1f7d9f27c3fa9df&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=550&height=312
 In just a few versions, you'll be able to participate in the testing of the revamped Hidden Pass!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2430170/Hidden_Pass/

Good luck, Wanderers!

notes.title: Alpha Version Playtesting is finished!
notes.notes:
Greetings Expedition Leaders!

After tons of feedback from you, we started improving lots of aspects:

 A new game UI has been introduced – interactions with the game are now simpler, clearer, and more visually appealing.
 Added trajectory lines for ranged attacks, making it easy to see if the shot will hit the target directly or not.
[previewyoutube=W8TLP57y4sk;full][/previewyoutube]
 Tutorials have been updated and now include videos – even if you don’t read them, it’s clear what to do 😉
 We’ve begun a large-scale effort to improve graphics – just take a look at this masterpiece!

notes.title: Hidden Pass Alpha Version is ready! Take part in Playtesting.
notes.notes:
Greetings Expedition Leaders!

We announce the playtesting of the Alpha Vertion soon. First 50 people are going to have the access today.

[previewyoutube=3INEyGIcu4w;full][/previewyoutube]

So let's stick to the list of new things:


 Color adjustments across all biomes to improve unit visibility.
 Animations for the Hight Demon are complete! They’ll be added to the game very soon!
 Actively preparing for the playtest, which is about to begin. We've been squashing bugs, fine-tuning the balance, and adding visual polish.
 Created a full tutorial for the global map, which was long overdue.
 For the "Academy" building in the Tower, we shot around 200 videos. These videos are displayed when selecting an ability for your hero to learn. It’s visually stunning!

notes.title: Dev Log #5. Alpha version is nearly ready!
notes.notes:
Greetings Expedition Leaders!

We will announce the playtesting of the Alpha Vertion soon. First, our dear backers are going to have the access.

So let's stick to the list of new things:

 Complete rebalance due to changes in the combat system design
 Received a lot of feedback and designed a new system for moving units, rendering direct/long-range shots, and a queue system
 In progress, design of a new combat UI
 Finished the emission on the global map. Now the interface displays the timer before it and shows the change in its strength.
 Implemented all the options for the consequences of the emission that will affect the player.
 Implemented the system of attacking the player's eoliths during the emission.
 Started work on changing the visuals of the game
 Worked on windows for constructing buildings on eoliths and Tower. Now these are full-fledged modal windows, which contain all the important information and descriptions of the buildings.
 Made icons of the undead abilities


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2430170/Hidden_Pass/

Good luck, Wanderers!
